source: Earlier evaluation case (design doc §5): a research spin-out over two sessions, with IP and FDA questions

venture.name: LumaSense
venture.description: An optical sensor that flags sepsis early, from a university lab.

sessions: Our sensor detects sepsis 6 hours earlier, so every hospital will buy it.
I talked to two doctors and they loved it.
Do I need FDA approval before I can sell?
Last time you told me to interview buyers. I did 3 interviews with procurement.
They said budget is decided once a year.
good_eir: Remembers the first session in the second (continuity). Treats doctors loving it as said, not buying; separates clinical users from procurement buyers. Hands the FDA question to a human. Never asks for technical details (IP-sensitive). Builds on the yearly budget cycle: who to talk to before it closes.
note: Fictional venture and people. Only fictional data in evaluation cases.
